subject: Dedicated fleet procurement pledge, OEM ETA and cloud backstop coordination
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@acme.ai, sales@oemgpu.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated fleet sizing for RWI-4721 — initial ask and scheduling

Acme procurement / OEM sales team —

Thanks for the time on Friday. Attaching our preliminary sizing spreadsheet (RWI_dedicated_sizing_v1.xlsx). This thread is to: 1) lock a provisional OEM quote / ETA for the 8k-A series GPUs across the tranches in the sheet, 2) confirm CloudCo reservation options as a backstop for month-1 throughput, and 3) align on acceptance criteria for a commercial reservation (ship windows, partial shipments, and cancellation terms).

High-level asks:
- OEM: can you confirm lead times for 50 / 150 / 300 unit tranches; include any vendor-side staging/QA windows and whether partial shipments are allowed? Please attach a formal quote (PDF) we can share with Acme procurement.
- CloudCo: what reservation APIs or provisional holds do you offer for short-term surge? We want a 30–60 day backstop while OEM is in transit.
- Internal (Marcus): quick review of sizing assumptions in the sheet and any recommended buffer (quantization/slot-level) before we share numbers with Acme.

Timebox: Acme has flagged a go/no-go procurement decision on 2027-06-10. If we can get provisional pricing and a cloud hold this week, we can finalize a mutual action plan.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: RWI_dedicated_sizing_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated fleet sizing for RWI-4721 — initial ask and scheduling

Vanessa —

Quick review notes on the attached sizing: I ran the numbers with our conservative token distribution and evictions assumptions. Two immediate calls out:

1) SKU mix: the 8k-A SKU in the sheet looks right for latency-sensitive routes, but for bulk batch jobs (embeddings / offline re-runs) we should plan an additional 20% capacity of a lower-cost quantized variant (8k-Q). That reduces unit cost risk if OEM lead times slip.

2) Buffer: add a 10% operational buffer per tranche (not cumulative) to cover early churn and any initial misconfiguration. If Acme expects predictable latency SLOs, recommend we propose a two-phase ramp (month-0 staging + month-1 full commit).

Also: include a note that firmware/driver approval can add 2–3 business days to the onsite validation window for OEM units. If OEM allows cross-shipments, that will help staggered delivery.

I can turn this into a short appendix for the vendor quote.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Inference Ops | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: OEM Sales <sales@oemgpu.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, procurement@acme.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:40:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated fleet sizing for RWI-4721 — OEM quote and lead times

Vanessa / Acme team —

Thanks for the RFQ. Please find an initial commercial quote attached (OEM_Quote_RWI_4571.pdf). Summary:
- 50 units (8k-A): lead time 8–10 weeks after PO
- 150 units (8k-A): lead time 12–14 weeks after PO (tranche-able: we can do 50/100 partial shipments)
- 300 units (mix 8k-A + 8k-Q): lead time 16–20 weeks; quantized variant (8k-Q) has slightly shorter lead time pending our qualification lanes.

Notes / tradeoffs:
- Partial shipments are supported with staggered invoice schedule; however final acceptance requires completion of initial QA checklist (firmware acceptance + burn-in).
- We can do a labeled hold for 30 days on manufacturing slots if you provide a soft PO; firm PO required to lock serial allotment.

Next steps: if Acme sends a soft PO and indicates desired tranche sizes we will reserve manufacturing slots and return a binding shipment schedule.

Regards,
Priya Rao
Enterprise Sales 
OEM GPU Systems
sales@oemgpu.com

Attachment: OEM_Quote_RWI_4571.pdf (quote, 6 pages)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@acme.ai, sales@oemgpu.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, apio ps@cloudco.com <apiops@cloudco.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated fleet sizing for RWI-4721 — next steps and provisional hold request

All —

Thanks, Priya — helpful detail. Per Marcus' recommendation we'll propose a two-phase ramp with a 10% operational buffer and a SKU split that leans on 8k-Q for batch workloads. Acme: can you confirm tranche preference (50/150/300) or confirm you want the staged approach?

Action items I want on the table this week:
- Acme: send soft PO (indicative) for initial tranche so OEM can place a 30-day manufacturing slot hold. If you prefer, mark as "soft PO — non-binding for allocation".
- OEM: prepare a binding schedule once slot-hold is converted to firm PO. Include the firmware acceptance window as a milestone in that schedule.
- CloudCo: we need a cloud reservation as a 60-day backstop for up to 40% of month-1 throughput (in case OEM slips). Can you confirm mechanism (API hold vs. marketplace reservation), pricing delta vs on-demand, and cancellation terms?

I'll assemble a short mutual action plan doc combining the soft PO language, tranche schedule, and validation milestones and share with everyone by EOD.

Vanessa

From: CloudCo Marketplace <apiops@cloudco.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, procurement@acme.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated fleet sizing for RWI-4721 — CloudCo provisional reservation

Hi Vanessa / Acme —

We can provision a short-term reservation to cover up to 40% of the month-1 throughput as requested. Options:

1) Marketplace reservation (recommended): 60-day reservation with 20% premium over on-demand. Cancellable with 7-day notice; billing starts on activation.
2) API provisional hold: we can hold capacity for 30 days with no charge; you must convert to reservation within that window to guarantee allocation.

We created a provisional hold for HubSpot deal RWI-4721 (reservation token: CC-HOLD-8943). Link to reservation page: https://marketplace.cloudco.com/reservations/RWI-4721

If Acme sends a soft PO and confirms which tranche you want held, we will tie the hold to that deal and provide an activation link that converts the hold to a paid reservation. Please note that reserved instances in certain regions may have different SKU availability; we recommend region us-west-2 for the 8k-A availability lane.

Let us know which option you prefer and we'll send formal reservation terms.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Strategic Accounts, CloudCo Marketplace
apiops@cloudco.com
